description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'ResetDatabaseCommand' used to reset the database to its initial state within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes namespaces, class definitions, and methods for command configuration and execution.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command class that resets the database to its initial state.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name 'instance:reset-db' that can be used to invoke this command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command by setting its description.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the database reset operation by calling restoreToInitialSavepoint and outputs success message.
